# CoWatch

> CoWatch is a web platform for watching videos and streams together with friends while communicating in real time.

## Public website

- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/: Main CoWatch landing page.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/about: Product overview and platform principles.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/creator: Creator information.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/faq: Frequently asked questions.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/support: Help and troubleshooting information.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/community-guidelines: Community standards.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/terms: Terms of service.
- https://cowatch.tomesphere.in/privacy: Privacy information.

## Product summary

CoWatch provides shared media viewing with synchronized playback and real-time communication features. The public site describes support for chat, voice/video communication, reactions, YouTube, personal media, and screen sharing. Feature availability may depend on the room, media source, browser, and current product configuration.

## Usage notes

- Treat room URLs, invitation links, account pages, and authenticated routes as private or session-specific.
- Do not infer private room contents, user identities, or account data from public URLs.
- Use the linked public pages as the authoritative source for current product and policy details.
